d: A religious leader delivers a discourse based on verses from the Bhagavata Purana and explains their spiritual significance to the devout.

Prince Rama embarks on a daring mission to save his kidnapped wife Sita from the evil Ravana. Aided by his loyal brother Lakshmana and an army of monkeys, Rama faces various challenges in his journey.
Lord Hanuman, a beloved deity in Hinduism, conquers various obstacles and overcomes insurmountable challenges in his quest to rid the world of evil.
KD Pathak is a brilliant defence lawyer who has a knack for winning every case he is assigned. He ensures justice prevails and sets innocent victims free in his own inimitable style.
ACP Pradyuman, Daya and Abhijeet are an elite trio of officers who work for the CID. Together, they seek the help of professional forensic expert Dr Salunkhe to solve various criminal cases.
Police officers investigate various instances of crime, collect evidence to solve cases with the help of their forensic technicians and bring the perpetrators to justice.
After her beloved Nagarjuna is murdered, a shape-shifting serpent vows revenge. Years later, she discovers he has been reincarnated as a wealthy man.
